I use Zepto everyday to order my morning milk, bread and eggs. It is a daily habit now. Very fast delivery, usually under 10 minutes.
I love ordering snacks, but I want to buy vegetables and organic chicken. However, the app doesn't show expiry dates or packaging dates, so I don't trust it. Stick to local vendor for veggies.
I discovered their beauty and personal care category today from the homepage banner. The variety of brands is good, but they need to show ingredients list of face washes.
Frustrated with Zepto! Twice they delivered rotten tomatoes. Customer support refused refund saying open box check was completed. How can I check every tomato in 10 seconds at the door?
Order again button is my favorite. I just open the app, click repeat order for my weekly groceries, and checkout in 1 minute. Very convenient.
I only buy from the dairy and beverage section. I want to explore other categories like kitchen tools or gourmet cheese, but the search doesn't give good recommendations.
Late night snacks delivery is a lifesaver. Usually order energy drinks and chips at 2 AM. Very quick service.
Why do they show irrelevant items in my cart recommendation? I am buying tea bags and it suggests detergent. Improve the recommendation system.
Discovered electronic accessories on Zepto and bought a charger. Good price, but I had to search specifically. Homepage doesn't highlight new categories well.
Extremely bad policy. They delivered wrong item and refused refund because of 'open box verification'. Support is useless.
